'''Order 1138''' was an order that was given by the [[Thaereian military]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Delas Fotrin]] crash-landed his [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]], he didn't activate his [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]], because doing so would go against Order [[1138 (easter egg)|1138]].
